sources.title: MC Digital Realty announces KIX15 construction
sources.summary: Operator confirms construction of the fifth KIX campus building in Ibaraki, Osaka, with planned 24 MW server power, 17,672.49 m² gross floor area, one basement and three above-ground floors. Service starts in Q4 2028 are a target.
sources.date_semantics: October 7 is the dated announcement confirming construction, not the exact physical start day. The company history separately places commencement in May 2026 without a day.

sources.title: MC Digital Realty corporate history
sources.summary: Corporate timeline records KIX15 construction start in May 2026.
sources.date_semantics: Undated current company page; May 2026 is month precision only. No invented first-of-month date or new status date from retrieval.

sources.title: Digital Realty KIX10 facility address and map coordinates
sources.summary: First-party facility payload names KIX10 at 5-8-1 Saito Yamabuki, Ibaraki-shi, Osaka and embeds latitude 34.8614235 and longitude 135.5158993.
sources.date_semantics: Undated location reference, not KIX15 status evidence. These are KIX10 constituent-property coordinates; the KIX15 association requires the separately disclosed annex identity review.

sources.title: Baxtel KIX15 facility profile and shared-property identification
sources.summary: Compiled facility reference identifies KIX15 as KIX10 Annex and reports shared lots 5-8-1 and 5-8-2 Saito Yamabuki. The gross floor area and floor configuration agree with the operator release.
sources.date_semantics: Undated compiled identity reference only. Its claim that work began on October 7 conflicts with the operator company history and is explicitly rejected. Its map coordinates, plans and capacity status are not selected.

sources.title: Digital Realty Q1 2024 supplement: KIX10 Annex land acquisition
sources.summary: Financial supplement records the acquisition of land named KIX10 Annex (MC Digital Realty), Osaka, on February 5, 2024.
sources.date_semantics: Historical acquisition context only. The document does not itself crosswalk the annex to KIX15 or establish a cadastral boundary, address, or construction date.

sources.title: MC Digital Realty KIX connected-campus profile
sources.summary: Operator markets several Saito-area facilities as its KIX connected campus. The geographic review distinguishes the Ibaraki KIX10 property from Minoh constituent buildings.
sources.date_semantics: Undated campus context only; network-connected campus branding does not establish a single physical parcel.

sources.title: Ibaraki landscape review: Saito Yamabuki data-center design
sources.summary: Municipal landscape presentation shows a new Saito Yamabuki data-center design in fiscal 2025 review materials. Its exterior arrangement resembles the KIX15 operator rendering, but the slide does not name KIX15 or supply a numbered parcel.
sources.date_semantics: Planning-design context only. The unnamed design is not used as permit, physical-work, or conclusive parcel-identity evidence.

sources.title: MC Digital Realty KIX15 construction announcement distributed on PR Times
sources.publisher: MC Digital Realty via PR Times
sources.attribution: MC Digital Realty via PR Times
sources.summary: Operator-distributed version corroborates the October 7 KIX15 construction statement, 24 MW planned server power, Ibaraki locality and Q4 2028 service target.
sources.date_semantics: Same corporate announcement as the direct operator source, not an independent status observation.

sources.title: MLIT structural certification register: KIX15
sources.publisher: Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
sources.summary: Register identifies KIX15 and applicant Digital Osaka 6 TMK under structural-method certifications MNNNNNN-12935 dated March 2, 2026 and MNNNNNN-12935-1 dated September 29, 2026. Listed address is the applicant office in Tokyo, not the data-center property.
sources.date_semantics: Exact certification dates, not general building-permit issuance or construction start. Record proves project/SPV identity only; no site address or geographic point.
